methods.primary_count: Assign a whole-path bend once to the phase containing its turning-weighted center. A shared turn can overlap several phases; overlap count is displayed separately and cannot be summed.
methods.sharpness: 90th percentile of curvature sampled uniformly by distance within the phase, from the globally smoothed trajectory. Higher values mean tighter local turning. It describes the sharper 10% of path, not maximum curvature or an average of trajectories.
methods.positions: Primary bend center normalized by arc length between semantic boundaries, not time or measured object distance.
methods.independence: Each point is one episode-phase. Whole-path events are correlated; only nine human episodes, no significance or general-population claim.
methods.qualification: Human ep36 excluded by user. Fabrics ranges/plots use nine qualified executions; the tenth failed execution is retained in JSON and the individual viewer.
methods.limits: Ring/pole and block-stacking tasks differ. Phase lengths differ; raw bend count should not be interpreted independently of length. Curvature is scale-dependent and not semantic evidence of an intentional correction.
methods.generation: Use this as an empirical library of coherent phase patterns. Do not independently sample count, location, angle and width or extrapolate nine demos as a population model.
